output.summary: A grass genus native to tropical and warm-temperate regions, Digitaria comprises slender annual and perennial plants with long, finger-like flower clusters. Seeds of named members—including two fonio species, Digitaria sanguinalis and Digitaria compacta—are eaten in several forms.
output.edibilityNote: Edible seeds include fonio species, D. sanguinalis and D. compacta; they may be toasted, made into flour or porridge, or fermented into beer.
